limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
Pre-reset state is unspecified by the original problem and is not constrained by the testbench.
interface_cycle_semantics: TopModule(clk, reset, q[3:0]); positive-edge decade counter; active-high synchronous reset to zero; 9 wraps to 0 on next rising edge.
numeric_width_decisions: 4-bit unsigned counter with explicitly sized constants.
pipeline: One update per rising clock edge; no extra latency.
static_review: Single always_ff driver, nonblocking assignments, specified reset priority and modulo-10 wrap.
